## Rule quality

If this adds or changes a rule:

- [ ] Metadata is complete
- [ ] Evidence is precise
- [ ] Severity and confidence are justified
- [ ] Remediation is actionable
- [ ] Insecure fixture detects it
- [ ] Secure fixture does not over-report
- [ ] Documentation is updated
